q: Which blood group is most common?
Calculate the percentage of people with group AB.
Explain how a person can have group AB.
The alleles Iᴬ and Iᴮ are codominant: someone with Iᴬ Iᴮ makes both A and B antigens.
Two parents are groups A and B. Their child is group O. Explain how, and give the parents’ genotypes.
Both parents must carry the recessive allele: Iᴬ i and Iᴮ i. The child got i from each, so ii = group O (1 in 4 chance).
